name: js_realloc_rt

ownership.argument: The composition primitive for the module is js_realloc_rt(rt, NULL, size): the realloc hook is the only exported malloc-family entry on this build, and realloc(NULL, size) is a malloc. Corrects the earlier assumption that 0xC2D10F8 is a js_malloc_rt wrapper; it is the realloc slot.

provenance.source: Disassembly is exact: R0 = *(rt+0x10); R3 = *(R0+8); R0 += 0x10; BLX R3, with r1 and r2 passed through untouched, so this is the realloc slot of the runtime memory hook table (table at rt+16, slot +8) called as (hook_ctx, ptr, size). The malloc slot is +0 of the same table and is NOT wrapped: every allocation site calls it inline, e.g. js_new_array_buffer 0xC2D34C8 does (*(rt+16))(rt+16+16, 28) for its 28-byte JSArrayBuffer, and the string/atom allocator does the same with len + 17.

notes: The composition primitive for the module is js_realloc_rt(rt, NULL, size): the realloc hook is the only exported malloc-family entry on this build, and realloc(NULL, size) is a malloc. Corrects the earlier assumption that 0xC2D10F8 is a js_malloc_rt wrapper; it is the realloc slot.
